page.overview:
Who is Lavatory Services truck?

The Lavatory Services truck is an unnamed character that was seen collecting waster from a plane, but not before Acer falling into it and was shocked.

He was servicing an airplane when Acer's tires were suddenly punctured by a bullet fired by Finn McMissile. Eventually, Acer lost control and ran into the cockpit of the plane being serviced by a lavatory service truck. He eventually ran out of the cockpit and into his tanker truck.

In Cars 2: The Video Game, on the airport sand runway, you can see several airport ground support vehicles, probably a Sanitary Services Truck.

The Sanitation Truck doesn't make a physical appearance in Cars 3, but when Smokey and Lightning McQueen are at Smokey's Automotive Service watching Doc McQueen's pedicures, there is a newspaper with a picture of Acer falling into a Sanitation Truck.
